description: NaNdS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NdS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent NdS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.95 Å. Nd³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NdS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent NdS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. All Nd-S bond lengths are 2.85 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Nd³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Nd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
